description: Implementation of ByteWriter class providing methods to write various data types into a byte buffer, including byte, byte array, uint32, int64, and C-style strings.

classes.name: ByteWriter
classes.description: A class providing methods to write different data types into a byte buffer.

methods.name: writeByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte into the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Copies a sequence of bytes into the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: fillBytes
methods.description: Fills a section of the buffer with a specified byte value.

methods.name: writeUint32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer into the buffer in little-endian order.

methods.name: writeInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit signed integer into the buffer in little-endian order.

methods.name: writeCString
methods.description: Writes a null-terminated C string into the buffer.
